scripts.bundle: NODE_ENV=production DEV=0 bun build --bundle --minify src/bin.tsx node_modules/yoga-wasm-web/dist/yoga.wasm --outdir dist --target node
scripts.bundle:windows: NODE_ENV=production DEV=0 bun build --bundle src/bin.tsx --outdir dist --target node && bun shim.ts dist/bin.js
scripts.bundle-macos: NODE_ENV=production DEV=0 bun build --bundle --minify src/bin.tsx --outfile GSH/GSH/bin.js --target node && bun shim.ts GSH/GSH/bin.js
scripts.build: bun run bundle && bun run compile
scripts.build-macos: bun run bundle-macos && bun run compile-macos
scripts.bundletest: NODE_ENV=production DEV=0 bun build -e yoga-wasm-web --bundle --minify src/bin.tsx --outdir dist --target node
scripts.buildtest: bun build -e yoga-wasm-web --compile src/app.tsx --outfile dist/app --target bun
scripts.postbuildtest: mkdir -p dist/node_modules && cp -r node_modules/yoga-wasm-web dist/node_modules && mkdir -p dist/bin && cp -r src/bin dist && chmod +x dist/bin/llmshell && cp uninstall.sh dist && cp -r src/examples dist
